photos.desc: Cast of the skull of the dinosaur Stegoceras validum on display at the American Museum of Natural History in New York. Specimen is AMNH 1685, cast from UALVP 2. Original collected in 1921 by GF Sternb
Reconstruction of Hanssuesia sternbergi , a pachycephalosaur from Canada.

Stegoceras validum life restoration. Proportions based on a skeletal reconstruction by Scott Hartman [1] and photos of the skull. The integument is based on that of some other small ornithischian dino
